readiness_label: diagnostic only, sound quality not validated

macos: OpenA8DJUSB.m USB transport and stream counters
physical music quality gate and iRig capture discipline

gnd-vinyl.alsa_name: GND lift for TC Vinyl mode

gnd-cd-line.alsa_name: GND lift for TC CD/Line mode

playback-4out.summary: Outputs A/B/C/D active; no input-control change.

traktor-dvs-vinyl.summary: A/B timecode vinyl; vinyl ground lift on; software lock on.

traktor-dvs-cd-line.summary: A/B timecode CD-line; CD-line ground lift on; software lock on.

vinyl-recording.summary: A/B phono capture mode; phono ground lift on; software lock on.

line-recording.summary: A/B line capture mode; CD-line ground lift on; software lock on.

dj-set-recording.summary: C/D line capture workflow; physical MIC/LINE state still matters.

effects-loop.summary: C/D duplex workflow; no hidden routing change.

microphone.summary: Front XLR workflow; requires physical MIC/LINE switch selection.

daw-multichannel.summary: A/B/C/D multichannel use; no deck-specific hardware mode change.

midi-only.summary: MIDI bridge workflow; no audio-control change.

ground-diagnostics.summary: Input/noise diagnostic posture; software lock on.

engineering-diagnostics.summary: Full diagnostic posture; software lock on.

linux_policy.pcm_shape: Validate snd-usb-caiaq stereo-pair substreams first; add aggregate 8x8 presentation only as user-space/client compatibility unless kernel evidence justifies a different shape.
hot_path: no heap allocation in isochronous completion path
no steady-state logging or string formatting in the hot path
no broad locks shared by audio, MIDI, and controls
no control-plane work in packet completion callbacks
fixed URB/ring ownership and bounded packet parsing only
validation: counters, install success, and enumeration are not sound-quality proof
normal listening candidate requires exact artifact physical capture
real music, external capture, reference comparison, CPU/xrun evidence
44.1 and 48 kHz pass before 88.2 or 96 kHz are claimed
